reviewer: blind-a / subsequent independent labeled visual review
method: Viewed full extended contact sheet, native 192x208 direction tiles, and an all-frame temporal contact montage extracted from refreshed preview GIFs. No real-time playback inspected.

idle.evidence: Stable planted stance with blink, head tilt, eye movement, and modest breathing changes; board remains gripped.

running-right.evidence: Right-facing nose and advancing rightward stride silhouettes; alternating bent and extended legs, arm pump, and board carried at torso. No conspicuous scale jump.

running-left.evidence: Left-facing counterpart with alternating leg phases and arm pump; board remains attached to carrying arm. No conspicuous scale jump.

waving.evidence: Free arm raises, hand changes wave pose, then returns to hip; holding hand stays on board.

jumping.evidence: Crouch, ascent, tucked airborne apex, descent, planted recovery; head and board proportions remain coherent through pose changes.

failed.evidence: Concerned brows, drooping posture, lowered gaze, and recovery read as disappointment.

waiting.evidence: Palm-up, chin-touch and head-scratch gestures convey waiting with distinct facial variation.

running.evidence: Stationary thinking/working gestures: temple touch, chin touch, idea finger and contemplative eyes. This is a busy/processing state, not a locomotion gait.

review.evidence: Board inspection, chin touch, approving gesture and settled smile read as reviewing.

identity.evidence: Consistent blond hair, blue eyes, teal shirt, orange shorts, bare feet and yellow board with blue wave graphic across rows.

boardAttachment.evidence: Board remains in hand or tucked under arm; jump board rises with body. No detached prop observed.

scalePopping.evidence: No conspicuous character resizing across neighboring frames; changes correspond to crouch, leg extension, head turn and jump height.

directions.cardinals: All four legible; no wrong quadrant or conspicuous reversal among sixteen directions.

continuity.evidence: Body, feet, and board anchors remain visually stable. Reported transparent spans at y=197..201 coincide with negative space between separated feet near the bottom, not visible interior body punctures. The 157.5->180 and 337.5->000 transitions have larger head-turn changes as reported; no quadrant reversal, detached neck or torso seam observed.

chroma.evidence: Validation reports zero opaque chroma and fringe pixels, zero transparent RGB residue, and no errors or warnings. Despill reports ok and preserved alpha. No chroma retry performed.

limitations: Intermediate 22.5-degree steps are not uniformly distinct at pet size; details recorded as direction warnings.
Temporal montage verifies pose sequence, not real-time cadence, easing or perceived loop smoothness.
GIF previews show stippled outline artifacts from palette/transparency conversion; final atlas contact sheet is the source for edge-quality assessment.
Running without a directional suffix is interpreted as busy/processing, matching its stationary thinking poses.
